svg.title: flume: every launch waits in its stream for room, runs in a place of its own, and lands
svg.desc: Five launches come in, each naming its kind, its points and its stream: the change csv-export, 8 points, and the fix parser-tabs, 2 points, in work; the chore bump-deps, 5 points, in personal; the change sso-login, 8 points, in work; and the chore readme-tour, 5 points, in personal. The host runs three agents at once. The stream work, priority 10, runs up to three agents and 13 points in flight, on the pool work, filled first to last; the stream personal, priority 0, runs up to two agents at a pace of 8 points a day, on the pool personal. csv-export, parser-tabs and bump-deps start at once, each in a place of its own, whose stages light in turn with a fresh agent each, on the account work-1, work-2 or personal. sso-login waits for room in work’s queue, short of its points bound, until csv-export’s last stage delivers and its points leave flight; then it starts on work-1. readme-tour waits in personal’s queue, short of its pace, even once personal runs no agent. Each place’s last delivery submits it to the merge queue; sluice tests it as merged and lands it on main, and flume tidies the place. A place’s points, and a stream’s points bound and pace, are decided and wait on their build.
